name: Repetition-Free Recursive Teaching Dimension
definition: A recursive teaching plan is *repetition-free* when no two teaching sets use the same set of coordinates.  The **repetition-free recursive teaching dimension** $\mathrm{rfRTD}(\mathcal H)$ is the least possible maximum teaching-set size among repetition-free recursive teaching plans for $\mathcal H$.
graph_summary: Recursive teaching dimension when the coordinate sets of all teaching samples must be distinct.
description: The repetition-free variant of recursive teaching dimension introduced by Doliwa--Fan--Simon--Zilles.

monotonic.proof: Restrict a repetition-free teaching plan to any subfamily, deleting empty batches.  Each retained teaching set is still a teaching set at its stage and the coordinate sets remain pairwise distinct.
